lines.zh: 我四条腿撑起身子往前走。
lines.en: I push up on four legs and walk.
My neck has grown a little longer.
I walk slowly across the mud.

lines.zh: 我沿着河走，边走边找草。
lines.en: I follow the river, grazing as I go.
Each step lands firmly.
I cross the mud and leave deep prints.
My prints behind me are deep.
I head for that stand of low trees.
I shift along without hurrying.
I turn and walk back.
I quicken my pace, and it's heavy.
I stop for a few mouthfuls.
I chew slowly, a long time.
My small forelimbs hang.
I rest in the shade of a tree.
The wind turns my head aside.
There's no other sound around.
My tail touches a tree.

lines.zh: 这一片草不够我吃一天。
lines.en: This much grass won't last me a day.
I check where the sun stands.
I snort and the grass moves.
I chew a leaf, very slowly.
I push the grass aside with a forelimb.
You're a little taller than me.
I raise my neck to look at you.
I don't know you; I'll step back.

lines.zh: 你站在我吃草的地方了。
lines.en: You're standing where I graze.
I tilt my head and watch you.
There's no grass in your hands.
I walk slowly toward the trees.
My pace is much slower than yours.
I stop in front of you and stay still.

lines.zh: 你要是一直站着，我就走了。
lines.en: If you keep standing there, I'll go.

lines.zh: 我把头低了低，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I dip my head a little in greeting.
I look back at you once.
My slender legs tremble once.
I shrink behind my mother.
It landed on my ribs.
I back two paces, slowly.
Blood runs down my leg.
I lower my head, breathing heavily.
I lean against a tree.
My tail stops moving.
I brace on the tree and straighten up.
Slower now, but I still walk.
I've got my eye on that clump.
I lower my head and take the whole clump.
I eat and swing my tail.
I graze beside you.

lines.zh: 你再给一点，我就跟着你。
lines.en: A little more and I'll follow you.
I pull the grass up roots and all.

lines.zh: 吃完我就靠着你站一会儿。
lines.en: When I'm done I'll lean near you a while.

lines.zh: 叶子递过来，我就当你是朋友。
lines.en: Hand me a leaf and I'll call you a friend.

lines.zh: 我这身小骨头，撞一下也晃。
lines.en: Small bones like mine rattle at a bump.

lines.zh: 这一下撞在我腿上，不疼。
lines.en: It lands on my leg; it doesn't hurt.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子低下来，让你过。
lines.en: My long neck dips so you can pass.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，土都翻起来。
lines.en: We collide and the soil turns over.

lines.zh: 我又慢慢站回原来的地方。
lines.en: I slowly return to my spot.
You're smaller than me; no harm done.
I glance at you and go back to eating.
My tail brushes you.
I have to move two steps away.
Her neck is slimmer than mine.
We walk to the tree together.
Her head presses my shoulder.
We circle slowly.
Our steps fall together.
She walks more steadily than I do.
We lean together in the sun.
She heads into the trees.
I stay and watch her go.
I bite down and pull up.

lines.zh: 这点东西我一口就没了。
lines.en: One bite and this is gone.
I pin it underfoot and gnaw.
It's too coarse; it's stuck in my mouth.
I eat slowly and carefully.
I swallow and my belly rumbles.

lines.zh: 我这么小，已经是蜥脚类。
lines.en: Small as I am, I'm a sauropodomorph.
I want to find another clump.
Something's moving over there.
I stretch my neck to see.
I walk slowly that way.
It's a little bigger than I am.
I settle my body lower.

lines.zh: 有东西靠近，我收住脚步。
lines.en: Something nears; I stop in my tracks.
Let me see what it means to do.
I keep my head behind my body.
If it charges, I'll ram it.
I plant all four legs.
It has come a little closer.
I retreat step by step.
It's following behind me.
That stand of trees is just ahead.
I squeeze between two trees.
It can't squeeze between the two trees.

lines.zh: 我抬高头，看清前面的动静。
lines.en: I raise my head to read the movement ahead.
One swing of my tail hits its leg.
It gives a small half step.
I shift back a little more.
It walks around the tree.
I break into a run, clumsily.
A few more steps and I stop.
I slap its legs with my tail.
It stumbles backward.
I claw at it with my forelimbs.
It lunges; I take it on the shoulder.
I lower my head and butt it hard.
It's shoved two paces.
I step on it once.
At last it backs off.
I shove it with my forelimbs.
I stand there and pant.
At last it walks off on its own.
I look back at the damage.
I walk slowly back to the grass.
My legs are still a bit weak.
I look the whole country over first.
I lower my head for two bites.

lines.zh: 我的脖子伸出去够叶子。
lines.en: I stretch my neck for leaves.
The sun is on my back.
I try a faster pace.
Four hollows stay in the ground.
I rise from the nest on unsteady legs.
I've marked where the water is.
I walk slowly into the shade.
The sun is warm on my neck.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩了一下，草全倒了。
lines.en: One tail swing and the grass all falls flat.
One deep breath and I start walking.
Fire catches my leg and I stumble around.
I fall into a pit, heavily.
Water climbs my neck and I struggle.
Something sticks in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那道光让我四条腿都软了。
lines.en: The light turns all four legs weak.

lines.zh: 饿得太久，我撑不住身子。
lines.en: Too long hungry, I can't hold myself up.
Lightning hits my back and I jolt.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我一直在往下。
lines.en: No ground under me; I keep going down.
